intro: The elements of music, instruments and the life of a musician, from rehearsal to tour.

palabras.consejo: The initial r is strong: RRIT-mo. You can mark it by clapping or tapping your foot.
The accent on the i separates the vowels: me-lo-DÍ-a. It is the music you hum without words.
Before playing you tune; if it sounds bad, it is out of tune. It comes from «fino», precise.
It is conjugated like «poner»: «compongo», «compones». The participle is «compuesto».
Feminine: «la compositora». The composer writes the music; the singer sings it.
A band rehearses before the concert. Careful: «ensayo» is also an essay.
You record an album, a song or a video. It is a regular verb: «grabo», «grabas».
It is written with g but sounds like h: HI-ra. «Estar de gira» is going from city to city.
You go up onto the stage. It is also the place where something happens: «el escenario del crimen».
A choir sings in several voices. «A coro» means all together: «respondieron a coro».
It is written with q: or-KES-ta. A dance band at a village party is also called that.
The accent on the i separates the vowels: ba-te-RÍ-a. It is also a phone's battery.
The v sounds like b and ch as in «chocolate»: byo-lon-CHE-lo. It is shortened to «chelo».
Playing «de oído» means without sheet music. You also say «sacar una canción de oído».
«Afinar» is to tune an instrument. The f is soft: a-fi-NA-do.
The accent marks the past form of «yo». Stress on NE.
The b sounds soft, like «v»: gra-BA-mos.
Future form with an accent on the last syllable: RE.
«Cuando» + subjunctive refers to the future: «cuando empiece».
Future of «entrar». The accent falls on RE.
«Sonar» changes o to «ue»: suene, suenan.
Feminine: «la trompeta». The stress is on PE.
Third-person future: «él entrará», «ella entrará».
Future of «ensayar», to rehearse. The y sounds like «y» in «yes».
The c before e sounds like «k» here: TO-ken.
Third-person future. The accent is on the last syllable.
Stress on the last syllable, marked with a tilde: al-ma-THEN.
The accent on MU shows the stress. Feminine is «música», music.
Related to «fino», fine. Here it means to get an instrument in tune.
The n sounds before m: ins-tru-MEN-tos. Masculine: «el instrumento».
The b sounds soft, like «v»: re-BO-ta.
A short word, like «con», with, but meaning «against».
From «polvo», dust. Stress on RYEN.
The reflexive «se» is attached at the end of the infinitive.
«Sala» is feminine: «la sala». Plural with -s.
The e and a are in separate syllables: te-A-tros.
From «repentino», sudden. The stress is on TI.
Family of «espectáculo», show. Stress on DO.
The stressed i forms its own syllable: me-lo-DI-as.
«Un segundo eterno» is a second that feels endless.
Third person of «afinar». Compare «afinan», they tune.
Masculine: «el estudio». The stress is on TU.
Third person singular of «grabar». Stress on GRA.
The c before a sounds like «k»: to-KAR.
«La partitura» is the written music. «Sin partitura» means without sheet music.

texto:
**The notes.** Spanish does not use letters: **do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, si**. Do mayor is what English calls C major.

**The music.** The **ritmo**, the **melodía**, harmony and the beat. The «letra» is what is sung.

**Instruments.** Strings: the violin, the **violonchelo**, the guitar. Wind: the flute, the trumpet. Percussion: the **batería**, the drum. You play an instrument and, before playing, you **afinas** it. Playing **de oído** is playing without sheet music.

**People.** The **compositor**, the conductor, the singer, the **coro** and the **orquesta**.

**The work.** **Componer** a song, **ensayar**, **grabar** an album, go up on the **escenario** and go on **gira**.

**Careful.** **Ensayar** is to rehearse; **la batería** is also a phone battery; **un concierto** is also a concerto.

For something that has not happened yet, after **cuando** and **hasta que** the **subjunctive** is used:

- **Cuando suene** la trompeta, entrará el coro.
- Ensayaremos **hasta que** todos **toquen** a la vez.

If you talk about a habit or something that already happened, the indicative is used: **Cuando suena** la trompeta, entra el coro.

With **antes de** comes the infinitive: **Antes de salir** de gira, el grupo grabará un disco.

ejemplos.estudio: Cuando suene la trompeta, entrará el coro.
ejemplos.alumno: When the trumpet sounds, the choir will come in.

ejemplos.estudio: Ensayaremos hasta que todos toquen a la vez.
ejemplos.alumno: We will rehearse until everyone plays together.
analisis: Ensayaremos hasta que todos toquen a la vez
hasta que todos toquen a la vez

ejemplos.estudio: Antes de salir de gira, el grupo grabará un disco.
ejemplos.alumno: Before going on tour, the band will record an album.

pregunta.texto: What does a musician do before playing?

opciones.explicacion: Yes: tuning is adjusting the instrument so it sounds right.
A tour is a trip of concerts; it is not done «before playing».
The applause comes after playing, not before.

frase.texto: El grupo ____ su nuevo disco en un estudio.

piezas.traduccion: El grupo ____ su nuevo disco en un estudio.

opciones.explicacion: «Desafinar» is sounding out of tune; you do not do «a disc».
Yes: «grabar un disco» is saving the music on a file or disc.
You tune an instrument, not an album.

frase.texto: La orquesta sale de gira por Europa

piezas.traduccion: The orchestra goes on tour around Europe

opciones.explicacion: Volume has nothing to do with «de oído».
That would be «con los ojos cerrados»; «de oído» is about hearing.
Yes: you play guided by ear and memory, not by the paper.

pregunta.texto: Which form does «cuando» take for the future?

frase.texto: Cuando ____ la trompeta, entrará el coro.

piezas.traduccion: Cuando ____ la trompeta, entrará el coro.

opciones.explicacion: Yes: for something in the future, «cuando» takes the subjunctive: «cuando suene».
The indicative serves for habits: «cuando suena, entra».
After «cuando» the future is not used, but the subjunctive.

pregunta.texto: What is a person who composes music called?

opciones.explicacion: The choir is a group that sings; it does not compose.
Yes: the composer is the one who writes the music.
A tour is a trip of concerts, not a person.
